boundaries.notes: Manifest/pack/binding versions and source/cooked/runtime descriptors are separately meaningful. Exact hashes and declared resource codecs/patch/tuning/dependency inputs must accompany native sessions. Verified bytes do not prove license rights, original whole-object closure, original engine equivalence, or production readiness. GameRuntime extends content identity with its integrated interaction metadata; do not equate the sealed B report with the final native descriptor.

The existing gateway authenticates against original account HTTP and Aries/TCP services. Its native.rs name does not mean a new authoritative Rust lot or SQL claim store. Session correlation, original directory/lot admission and legacy messages remain separate from F-owned native runtime envelopes. Do not infer complete W13-W15 services or production native endpoints from the controlled browser fixtures.

This is the original FreeSO compatibility lane. FSOv version 38 is decoded as RefreshOnly presentation, not an A SimState restore or proof of identical RNG consumption. Original VM tick IDs are u32 and random seeds u64; numeric/string/wire conversions are explicit. Original native pre-tick snapshot semantics must not be relabelled native state-after-N. No FSOv-to-native continuous VM translation is established by this source map.

AcceptedTick carries u64 lot/epoch/tick, ContentDescriptor, rng_before and ordered AcceptedCommands. Authority and Replica run the same accepted transition; only authority exposes durable dispatches. Construction of an AcceptedTick or the Authority enum is not authentication. Preserve 30-Hz semantic ticks independently of render/network batching. TickOutcome acceptance/events are distinct from durable completion.

WLDSNAP with format version 1 and separately versioned simulation state is state AFTER completed tick N; accepted tail begins N+1. Fixed-width little-endian canonical payload, content/lot/epoch and semantic validation are distinct from transport authentication. The checksum is corruption detection, not an ownership grant or a database ledger. Historical avatar bone channels and private EOD provider state must not be guessed from this public snapshot.

OperationId contains a big-endian u64 namespace plus a monotonically allocated nonce in 16 bytes; epochs are separate fencing credentials. The stable operation identity survives retries/takeover. Public typed continuation data does not authorize arbitrary memory writes, restore money, execute transactions or contain private EOD state. E must authenticate/reconcile durable outcomes and avoid charging twice after lost receipts; that production provider is not proved here.

ObjectId is signed i16; raw zero/negative sentinels remain representable but only positive IDs and nonzero u32 generations denote live native entities. PersistentId is u32. Preserve exact widths and generation checks across browser/service mappings; presentation string IDs are a separate domain.

Current WLB1 bootstrap, WLC1 invocation/cancellation and WLA1 correlated acknowledgement are distinct from WLR1 replay. Admitted source_epoch/lot_incarnation are u64 and avatar_id/lot_location u32. The server supplies the authenticated principal/actor and revalidates the exact source action and current queue under its authority lock. A matching receipt is not VM completion or durable transaction truth; unresolved writes stay Unknown and are not replayed. Declared bootstrap content and the local test authority do not supply production account, claims or persistence services.

Browser/source/lot identity and local callback/request generations fence recovery. Accepted batches commit only after all ticks/post-state hashes validate; failures expose no prefix. Checkpoints cannot rewind the committed cursor, and older checkpoints must cross its exact hash with a contiguous tail. Recovered historical presentation outcomes and duplicate ticks are not new effects. Per-tick avatar samples are bounded presentation traces, not a second simulation or altered wire ABI.

Read-only world/appearance and per-accepted-tick avatar frames consume native state with explicit source resources and identities. Camera/GPU tickets and retained bone history confer no simulation authority. Missing models/resources stay diagnosed; fresh checkpoint or exhausted presentation history resets missing channels instead of inventing them. Client #35 terrain and #38 audio are separate branch inputs requiring map refresh when integrated; this intake is pinned to #39/#40.

WLR1 is the current native checkpoint/tick framing, not FSOv/VMNet. It uses bounded canonical fixed-width little-endian native serialization and local connection/request correlation. Pass native u64 values as bytes rather than JavaScript Number. Guarded allocation/depth credits are not a process-RSS limit. Transport still owns prebuffer message bounds, authenticated admission, revocation and overload policy.

Opaque presentation IDs and display Availability are not native object IDs, permissions, or a multiplayer wire ABI. The existing EntityRef uses a string ObjectId and u64 generation; do not cast it into the source-width native EntityRef. This map does not freeze or upgrade the UI contract.

open_decisions: Review and freeze the real native service/session/claim envelope with A/B/E and local Codex; current observed source pins are not a completed ABI freeze.
Evaluate the three SDK projects, imported targets, transitive ProjectReferences, source registries and effective resource cohorts before claiming a complete active capability census.
Reconcile original C# extracted probes and the real original runtime harness; native=WASM is not original-engine differential equivalence.
Establish independent authenticated players, fenced SQL claims and stable durable operations against real providers; fixture replicas of one actor are not W17.2 acceptance.
Define explicit exclusion/projection of private EOD state before production snapshot/hash/trace qualification; public payload comments alone are not a privacy audit.
Coordinate #35/#38 runtime-interface changes and #37 overlap with local Codex; refresh pins only alongside reviewed mapping changes and rerun the appropriate original gates.
